name: 44473 · Vienna, OH
findings: ZIP 44473 (Vienna) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44473 (Vienna) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44473 (Vienna) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
